title: Repository-Write Chain Collector Replay Attestation
primary_claim: A separately controlled collector can rerun the canonical six-verifier repository-write chain from exact raw authentication inputs, require an exact match with the retained chain-result artifact, and authenticate the result/artifact/report/toolchain identity with a short-lived signature.
acceptance: the issuing path invokes build_repository_write_chain_result with exact typed raw authentication inputs
non-runtime bindings and their collector-secret map are forwarded to the canonical builder rather than reconstructed from JSON
a hand-authored all-verified chain result is refused when it differs from the collector replay
artifact evidence and the byte-verification receipt must exactly match the replayed chain result
the attestation signs exact report, artifact, verification, byte, chain, inventory, classification, stage-set and toolchain digests
unknown keys, signature substitution, foreign collector identity and foreign toolchain identity are refused
current source revision and source-tree revision must match the attestation and every retained subject
future, expired, overlong and pre-evidence attestations are refused
negative replay outcomes may be retained but cannot be transformed into evidence_authenticated=true

verification.python_ast_parse: passed for implementation, focused tests and mutation runner
verification.exact_repository_focused_tests: not executed in this connector session
verification.bounded_mutation_execution: not executed in this connector session
verification.hosted_ci: issue #67 remains open; absent or zero-step runs are not evidence
verification.evidence_class: author-side source construction, static syntax, and isolated dependency-stub smoke; no exact-repository or exact-head green claim
verification.isolated_dependency_stub_smoke: passed for exact replay issuance, signature verification, and refusal of a retained chain result that differs from collector replay

non_goals: modifying GateReport-v4 placeholder-removal or non-runtime reconstruction semantics
resolving a CAS locator or defending a path-level TOCTOU read
making the repository candidate its own trusted collector
release-verifier admission, OwnerApproval, merge, promotion or Gate transition
next_packet: After PR #231 uses one shared inventory/classification snapshot and preserves verified non-runtime bindings, require a valid collector replay attestation before any GateReport or release-verifier path may treat the chain result as authenticated.
